  {
   "cell_type": "code",

   "id": "41d70211",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def plots(columnname, top10 = False):\n",
    "    prop = df.groupby(columnname, as_index= False)['final_grade'].mean()\n",
    "    prop['proportion'] = (prop.final_grade / df.final_grade.sum())* 100\n",
    "    prop = prop.sort_values('proportion', ascending = False)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    if top10 == True:\n",
    "        prop = prop.tail(10)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    fig2 = px.pie(data_frame= prop, names= columnname, values= 'final_grade')\n",
    "  \n",
    "    fig2.show()\n",
    "    "
   ]
  },

  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 53,
   "id": "de7123ac",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def plots2(columnname, top10 = False):\n",
    "    prop = df.groupby(columnname, as_index= False)[['previous_grade','study_time_hours']].mean()\n",
    "    prop['proportion'] = (prop.previous_grade / df.previous_grade.sum())* 100\n",
    "    prop = prop.sort_values('proportion', ascending = False)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    if top10 == True:\n",
    "        prop = prop.tail(10)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    fig2 = px.pie(data_frame= prop, names= columnname, values= 'previous_grade')\n",
    "    \n",
    "    fig2.show()\n",
    "   "
   ]
  },
